description: This file defines serialization, deserialization, and copying logic for the ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue> type in Orleans serialization framework, including codecs, surrogates, and deep copy implementations.

classes.name: ConcurrentDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer for ConcurrentDictionary, converting to and from a surrogate for serialization.

classes.name: ConcurrentDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate type used during serialization to represent a ConcurrentDictionary as a Dictionary for serialization purposes.

classes.name: ConcurrentDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Provides deep copying logic for ConcurrentDictionary instances.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate representation back into a ConcurrentDictionary.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a ConcurrentDictionary into its surrogate representation.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of a ConcurrentDictionary instance, creating a new copy with duplicated keys and values.
